outcome: The issue page records owner updates and replies, sets the owner and messages the owner (SCR-30 part 2)
acceptance_criteria: `/work/5111` shows the update form only; posting Progress with a note, next action and a chosen proof sends exactly one POST to `/api/v1/work/5111/issue-followup` with the body shape above, `team_reply:null`, `task_id`/`task_revision` from `response_task`, and the page then shows the re-read status — verify: e2e records the request and compares it to the fixture JSON.

`/work/5112` (team owner, no task) shows the reply form and sends one POST to `/projects/{case}/issues/{issue}/team-replies` with a uuid `operation_key`, `assignment_id` 7, channel and source reference; it sends nothing to `issue-followup` — verify: e2e. `/work/5111` never calls `team-replies` — verify: e2e request log.
The update form with `team.mode:'team'` sends `team_reply` with `assignment_id`, a uuid `operation_key`, party, channel, `responded_at` null when blank — verify: unit test on the descriptor body.

Every write body carries `expected_revision`/`case_revision` (or `case_revision` alone for project routes) from the correct read, never 0, never inside `inputs`; with a `null` token the control is disabled with the reload text and no request is made — verify: unit tests on each descriptor and `grep` that no `inputs` object holds a revision or key.

Flags: with 5119 no control is drawn; with `can_record` false the update and reply forms are absent; with `can_request_update` false "Message owner" is absent — verify: unit test on the visibility table and e2e on 5119.

Proof: no proof is preselected; submit is off with an empty list; the evidence id sent is one from the served list; no file input is on the page — verify: unit test and e2e; `grep -rn "fileToEvidence" frontend/src/features/issue-followup` returns nothing.

`/work/5113` Set an owner reads `GET /projects/{case}/issues` only when the form opens, lists the owner names from `owners[]` with none preselected, and sends one `assignment` POST with `mode:'internal'`, `recorder_id`, `state_id`, `evidence_id`, `reason`, `work_id`; the Owner fact changes only after the re-read — verify: e2e; no external-team option appears.

Message steps follow the structure table: 5114 offers only Prepare; 5115 Edit and Review; 5116 only Send to the owner; 5117 Check what happened, Record it by hand and Cancel; 5118 offers Prepare only and shows the receipt — verify: unit test on `messageSteps.ts` for all five fixtures; the `status` text is never read (grep).

Release sends one request on one press (double click sends one), needs a chosen channel and "Acting as", and no step releases anything automatically on load, poll, timer or tool text — verify: e2e counting POSTs; `grep liveApi.POST` shows sends only through `useWorkCommand`.

Uncertain send: a dropped connection on release locks the message controls, re-reads, shows the uncertainty message, offers only Check what happened, and does not send a second release until the re-read changes `dispatch_id`/`receipt`/`case_revision` or the page is reloaded — verify: e2e with the failure switch and a request count.
A message with `receipt:null` shows "No receipt yet" and never "Delivered"; "Delivered" shows only when `receipt.delivered` is true — verify: unit test and e2e on 5117 and 5118.

Wrong person / wrong tenant / invalid input: 403 shows "You can't do this." with the server message and re-reads; 404 shows "This record is unavailable."; 409 re-reads and shows the stale text without repeating the press; 422 shows the server message and `fields[]`; `csrf_failed` refreshes the session once and sends nothing by itself; 503 shows "Try again shortly." — verify: mock scenarios and unit tests on each.

Empty note, missing update type, missing proof, missing channel or source reference (team form) keep submit off with the field named; limits (2000/4000 characters) are enforced before sending — verify: unit tests.

A provider/delivery failure is not success: after `release` with a 201 the page says "Sent. Waiting for the receipt" and only a served `receipt` changes it — verify: e2e on 5116 then 5117 fixture sequence.
The case id and issue id sent come only from the loaded work item and reads; no input accepts either — verify: unit test on request URLs with a changed `case_id`.

`IssueFollowupActions` is registered through the adapter's `Actions` slot and the issue page works without it for a line with no `Actions`; no file under `frontend/src/features/workspace` or `work-item` is changed — verify: `git diff --stat` and a unit test.

Against live Django (8030, an account that can see an issue) the update and the message prepare are exercised once each against a test project; the status of each answer and the page after re-read are recorded in build.md. The live result of Set an owner (Question B2) is recorded as found — verify: curl the three reads before and after and compare with the page.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390 on the four SCR-30 states plus the forms: boards' parts remain; added forms use CMP-04 fields, CMP-09 buttons and CMP-18 callouts and leave no empty heading — verify: screenshots reviewed against SCR-30 artboards.
New tests cover descriptors, step derivation, the visibility table, the uncertain-send lock and error mapping; `npm run lint`, `typecheck` and `npm test` pass — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: High. `issue_communications_command` releases an external message (external-messaging) and `assignment` changes who is accountable, with concurrency through `expected_revision` and `case_revision` and uncertain-send recovery (`apps/core/factory_api`, `contracts/psl-factory.openapi.json` around lines 46390 to 47245). It moves no money and touches no payroll or identity data. It needs UI review, a security review for the permission and idempotency handling, and the design engineer's merge batch.
